missions.title: First Watch
missions.briefing: Three boats out of Porthkell tonight. Clear sky, easy sea. Keep them in your light and they'll keep their heads.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Gannet Head, Little Auk. Coming home with a full hold. Light us in, keeper?

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake leaving Porthkell. Heading east for the morning.

ships.name: Saint Brannoc
ships.hail: Saint Brannoc passing along the coast. Evening, Gannet Head.

ships.name: Dunlin
ships.hail: Dunlin, inbound from Corley. Long night.

radio.text: Evening, keeper. Ianto at the harbour. Quiet one to start you off.
LETTER FROM THE BOARD OF LIGHTS: Gannet Head Light will be discontinued at the close of the season. A radio beacon will replace it. Twelve nights remain.
Twelve nights. Well. Let's make them count.
A boat in the dark loses its nerve. Get your light on her.
That's the lot. Porthkell sleeps sound. Goodnight, keeper.

missions.title: The Teeth
missions.briefing: Boats coming down past the Merrow Teeth. The reefs are under the water; sweep your light ahead of them so the captains can see the rocks in time.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Little Auk again, keeper. Coming down past the Teeth. Mind them for me?

ships.name: Guillemot
ships.hail: Guillemot inbound from the east.

ships.name: Fulmar
ships.hail: Fulmar, bound for Corley the long way round.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Gannet Head, this is the Calloway. Pryce. I know these rocks better than you do, but light them anyway.

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater coming down from the north.

radio.text: The Teeth are out there, keeper. Underwater. A captain only steers round what he can see.
Thanks, keeper! I can see the white water now.
Far out? Hold your light steady. It'll reach further.
Hm. Not bad. Not bad at all.

missions.title: Lantern Row
missions.briefing: Black Hen throws a long shadow your light can't reach. The channel buoys have lamps: light them, and they'll guide the boats a while on their own.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk here. Coming down behind Black Hen, keeper. Can't see your light from here!

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill from the west, inbound.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway. Same rocks as last night. Same keeper, I hope.

ships.name: Petrel
ships.hail: Petrel, on the Hen's side.

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater coming down past the Teeth.

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen, through traffic, eastbound.

radio.text: Light the Hen Bell before the Auk gets there. A burning buoy keeps a boat steady.
Ha! The bell's lit. I'm alright now, keeper.
You're the only one awake round here, aren't you?
Lantern Row's all lit. Nicely done.

missions.title: Deep Water
missions.briefing: Colliers tonight. A steamer draws four fathom, and the Long Sands will take her keel where a trawler floats over. Light the sands for the big ships.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway again. Coming down for Porthkell across the Sands. Mind them for me, keeper. I can't.

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill inbound from the west.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake heading out. Fair night for it.

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen, collier, inbound from the east.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk's coming home behind the Hen. Wave the light, keeper!

ships.name: SS Penhallow
ships.hail: Penhallow, loaded deep. Making for Porthkell.

ships.name: Dunlin
ships.hail: Dunlin coming in along the coast.

radio.text: Long Sands are shifting again. Shallow enough to wade at low water. Light them up before a steamer gets there.
Sands lit. Good. I'll go round.
Steamers turn like a church. Give them warning early, keeper.
Hm. You'll make a keeper yet.

missions.title: Sea Fret
missions.briefing: Sea fret rolling in off the water. Your light won't carry through it unless you hold it narrow, and the boats will lose their nerve quick. Sound the horn if they're lost.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk here. Can't see my own bow, keeper. Keep that light coming.

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater in the fret, coming down from the east.

ships.name: SS Hesper
ships.hail: Hesper, eastbound. Thick as porridge out here.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake going out. Lord knows why.

ships.name: Guillemot
ships.hail: Guillemot, inbound, blind as a mole.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway in the fret. I'll take your horn over your light tonight, keeper.

ships.name: Fulmar
ships.hail: Fulmar, passing north of the Teeth.

radio.text: Fret's thick. Hold the light narrow to punch through it. And when they lose you, give them the horn.
I heard you! I know where I am now!
Silhouettes in the fog. That's a sight. Good work.

missions.title: The Evening Star
missions.briefing: The Evening Star's running a late crossing: forty passengers and the Porthkell brass band. Bring her in with everyone else, and don't let her near the Ledge.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star, out of Corley with forty souls and a brass band! Evening, Gannet Head!

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk again. Is that the band I can hear?

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen departing east.

ships.name: Saint Brannoc
ships.hail: Saint Brannoc along the coast, eastbound.

ships.name: Puffin
ships.hail: Puffin inbound from the east.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star again, going back out! The band wants to play for the lighthouse!

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway. Will someone tell that ferry to stop playing the trombone.

ships.name: Curlew
ships.hail: Curlew, westbound along the shore.

radio.text: Ferry's worth more than the rest put together, keeper. In every way.
Everyone wave at the lighthouse! Go on!
Ooh, we're all lit up! Lovely!
Home safe. Three cheers for the keeper! Hip hip!

missions.title: Mayday
missions.briefing: The Calloway's dynamo has failed: no lamps, and she's shipping water somewhere off the Teeth. You'll not see her till your light finds her. Watch for the flares.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Gannet Head, Calloway. We've lost the dynamo. No lamps, taking water. North of the Teeth, I think. Find us.

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill inbound. Is that the Calloway in trouble?

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk going out to stand by the Calloway. Don't lose me too!

ships.name: Dunlin
ships.hail: Dunlin inbound from the east.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star, passing. Thinking of you, Calloway!

ships.name: Guillemot
ships.hail: Guillemot. Something dark on the water off Widow's Ledge, keeper. No lamps at all.

ships.name: SS Hesper
ships.hail: Hesper, eastbound along the coast.

ships.name: Petrel
ships.hail: Petrel inbound behind the Hen.

radio.text: No lamps on her, keeper. Sweep the dark till you find her, and keep her lit.
That's a flare gone up. Look for it, keeper!
...Obliged to you. Truly.

missions.title: Squall
missions.briefing: Glass is falling fast. The current runs hard onto the rocks in a blow, and the rain will cut your reach. The lightning's your friend tonight: it shows the reefs.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: This is no night for a little boat, keeper. Running for home!

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake running for shelter!

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen, making for Porthkell, heavy weather.

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill in from the west, taking it green over the bow.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star must sail, keeper, mail and all. Hold on to your hats!

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater coming down past the Teeth. Can't see a thing between the flashes.

ships.name: SS Penhallow
ships.hail: Penhallow eastbound. The current's pushing us shoreward.

ships.name: Fulmar
ships.hail: Fulmar inbound.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway, coming home through the worst of it. Light on, keeper.

radio.text: Storm's on us. The current will push them onto the rocks if they lose their way.
Every flash of lightning shows the reefs. Use it.
I saw the Teeth in the lightning! Ugly things.
Hell of a night. Hell of a light.

missions.title: False Light
missions.briefing: Word from Corley: lanterns seen on the cliffs at night. The Corley brothers, wrecking again. A captain will steer for any light that turns like yours. Put your beam on theirs and they'll douse it.

ships.name: Dunlin
ships.hail: Dunlin inbound along the east coast.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk here. Someone's playing silly devils on the Corley cliffs, keeper.

ships.name: SS Hesper
ships.hail: Hesper, westbound along the coast.

ships.name: Puffin
ships.hail: Puffin inbound from the east.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star coming in from Corley. Which of those lights is yours, keeper?

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake going east.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway. I've heard about the Corleys. Keep your eye on them.

ships.name: Saint Brannoc
ships.hail: Saint Brannoc, eastbound.

ships.name: Morwenna
ships.hail: Morwenna, westbound.

radio.text: Watch the cliffs at Corley Cove. If a light shows that isn't yours, hold your beam on it.
There! A false light at Corley. Put your beam on it!
That's sent them running. They'll be back, mind.
They want us on the rocks for the salvage. Wicked.
The Corleys went home empty-handed. Well done, keeper.

missions.title: Two Lights
missions.briefing: Fret again, and the Corleys have learnt to move. Black Hen one hour, West Point the next. And a letter from the Board, for what it's worth.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk, behind the Hen again. Two lights out here tonight. Which is you?

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill in from the west.

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen, eastbound, far out.

ships.name: Guillemot
ships.hail: Guillemot inbound.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star, along the coast. The passengers love the fog, keeper. I don't.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake out past the Hen.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway, coming down past the Teeth. Two lights. I'll trust the one I know.

ships.name: Petrel
ships.hail: Petrel, passing north.

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater inbound.

ships.name: SS Penhallow
ships.hail: Penhallow making for harbour from the west.

radio.text: The Board notes reports of 'false lights' on the Merrow coast. Such matters will be moot once the radio beacon is commissioned.
Moot, he says. Tell that to the Auk.
Now West Point. They've a boat to row between them.
Two lights, and they followed the right one. That's you, keeper.

missions.title: The Mimic
missions.briefing: The Corleys have a bigger lantern now, on the Sentinels' cliff, and they turn it round and round, just like yours. The captains can't tell you apart unless you're on them.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Two lights turning, keeper. Swing yours my way so I know.

ships.name: Saint Brannoc
ships.hail: Saint Brannoc, eastbound.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway. I've rounded this Head four thousand times. I know your light, keeper.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake going east.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star, westbound along the cliffs. Ooh, two lighthouses!

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater coming down past the Teeth.

ships.name: SS Hesper
ships.hail: Hesper inbound along the coast.

ships.name: Guillemot
ships.hail: Guillemot inbound.

ships.name: Curlew
ships.hail: Curlew, westbound.

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen, eastbound.

ships.name: Fulmar
ships.hail: Fulmar inbound.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star going back out. Keep the real one shining!

radio.text: The false one turns like yours. Don't chase it every time. Stay with your ships.
The Board advises the radio beacon will be commissioned at the close of the season, as planned.
Told you. I know your light.

missions.title: Last Light
missions.briefing: Last night of the season, keeper. And of course it's the worst one: a full gale, the Corleys out for one last wreck, and every boat in Porthkell at sea. Bring them home.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Last night, keeper! Auk's coming home, and she's staying home.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.hail: Kittiwake running for shelter.

ships.name: Evening Star
ships.hail: Evening Star! We've lost the lamps and we're taking water! Forty souls aboard, keeper!

ships.name: Razorbill
ships.hail: Razorbill in from the west.

ships.name: SS Maud Ellen
ships.hail: Maud Ellen coming down past the Teeth.

ships.name: Little Auk
ships.hail: Auk going back out. Someone has to stand by the Star.

ships.name: SS Penhallow
ships.hail: Penhallow eastbound.

ships.name: Petrel
ships.hail: Petrel behind the Hen.

ships.name: Dunlin
ships.hail: Dunlin westbound.

ships.name: SS Hesper
ships.hail: Hesper, far out.

ships.name: Shearwater
ships.hail: Shearwater coming down.

ships.name: SS Calloway
ships.hail: Calloway, coming home for the last time on your light, keeper. Let's do it properly.

radio.text: Everyone's out, keeper. Last night, and the worst one. Bring them home.
We can see your light! Keep it on us!
One last wreck, lads. The beacon won't light the cliffs for him.
That's the gale blowing itself out. Dawn's coming.
